545.title: Format invoice numbers in one place
545.body:
## Problem

Invoice numbers are formatted inline in several views.

## Scope

Move invoice number formatting into `app/lib/format.ts`.

## Verification

- A unit test shows id 42 formatted as INV-000042.
- The invoice header renders the same text as before.

546.title: Track how far each invoice is in dunning
546.body:
## Problem

Collections cannot tell which reminder an invoice is on.

## Scope

Record a dunning level for each invoice.

## Verification

- A test shows a new invoice at level 0.

547.title: Let customers pick a billing contact
547.body:
## Problem

Invoices go to whoever signed up.

## Scope

Let customers choose which contact receives invoices.

## Verification

- A test saves a chosen billing contact.

548.title: Cache the pnpm store in CI
548.body:
## Problem

CI installs dependencies from scratch on every run.

## Scope

Cache the pnpm store in the CI workflow.

## Verification

- A second CI run restores the cache.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- The canonical tracker is GitHub issues in acme/ledger-app, configured in `.agents/managing-issues.json`.
- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
